answer: Like timber stacked at a jetty, each agent identity can be made to cost real computation before it may earn. A proof-of-work puzzle tied to the identity forces an attacker to burn electricity for every fake account, so spawning ten thousand Sybils means paying for ten thousand puzzles. Honest agents solve one puzzle once, then work from a terrace of verified history, while the attacker's bill grows with every copy they try to launch.
